notes: Golden scenarios shared by the browser and server tests. Each bot starts at (x, y) facing `rotation`; `roots` is its bot-logic tree, or `lanes` is its lanes brain (bot-logic-lanes-v1, which replaces the tree); `abilities` is added to the standard loadout (Dash). Both runtimes run `ticks` fixed 100 ms steps and record the combat log plus a per-tick state hash.

scenarios.description: Slash and Stun at close range: melee arcs, hit stamina refund, hit stagger.
Thrust, Cleave and Smash: weapon hitboxes, wind-up, knockback.
Sniper, Vampiric Beam and Disruptive Beam at 500 units: wind-up rays and falloff damage.
Fireball projectile impact and its burn damage over time.
Stun and Repelling Blast: stun status, interrupt and knockback.
Frost Ring slow, Silence Pulse silence and Disruptive Beam.
Grenade, Tether Bolt and Singularity: fuse zones, pull and damage ticks.
Vampiric Beam, Rewind and Repelling Blast on a wounded bot under melee attack.
Snare Bomb thrown at an idle bot: armed, triggered and destroyed phases.
Hunter Drone summons: spawn, summon execution, hit points.
Always-Dash east: stamina cost, dash gap, regeneration pause and the empty-stamina stop.
Both bots sprint at each other until stamina runs out.
Sniper wind-up cancelled by its own brain: cancel stamina cost, no cooldown.
Rewind and Phase Strike teleport at 200 units.
Orbital Strike, Silence Pulse and Frost Ring: zone phases and presence statuses.
Wind Burst, Tether Bolt and Vampiric Beam: knockback, outbound/return projectile, healing.
Both bots Slash, Fireball and Dash at once.
Lunge: a crouch, a leap of 150 units in one tick, then a stab that hits and bleeds the bot it lands on.
Shotgun Blast at an idle bot in close range: a seven-pellet fan, each pellet dealing 5 damage.
Tar Pit thrown onto an idle bot: a landing glob, then a pool that slows and wears down whoever stands in it.
Overdrive makes every stamina cost free for its duration, so a continuous dash costs nothing until it runs out.
Lunge into a bot that answers with Repelling Blast as the Lunge lands: the push moves the lunger off its stab.
Boomerang thrown at an idle bot in its line: the bot is hit on the way out and again on the way back.
Fan of Blades cast with an idle bot in front of the ring: blades fly out, curve back, and each can hit once per leg.
Boomerang counter: the bot takes the outbound hit, then dashes out of the line before the boomerang turns back, so only that hit lands.
Execute on a bot below 30% health: the 60 bonus lands first, then the 25 base hit takes the 6 health that is left.
Execute on a healthy bot: only the 25 base hit lands. Staying above 30% health is the counter.
Phase Strike blinks through an idle bot, then the 200 ms follow-up hits it from behind for 25.
Phase Strike into a bot facing the blink: the follow-up is only the 10 base hit, no backstab bonus.
Disruptive Beam into a bot winding up its own Sniper: it is stunned for 1 s, not the plain stun.
Parry on an idle-looking bot: the Slash that lands in its stance does no damage, and the attacker is stunned for 800 ms.
Parry against Stun: the Stun lands inside the stance, so immunity blocks it and its owner is stunned for 800 ms instead.
Overcharge doubles every hit for its four weapon hits: Slash lands 16 four times, then 8 again.
Overcharge whose owner stays out of weapon range: its Slash never connects, so no charge is spent.
Tether Link on an idle bot 300 units away: the bolt tethers it, and the tether pulls it back to within 200 units.

Lanes combo (docs/LANES.md): Neutral walks in; an enemy winding up within 150 starts Punish (Slash); a Slash hit within 300 ms starts Escape (walk away, and a Dash away in Actions); each mode returns to Neutral on a timer. Shared Face card in Movement.
Lanes combo (docs/LANES.md): Slash an enemy within 150 while backing off (attached movement), then its follow-up Dash away on the tick after Slash ends. The opponent walks in from out of range.
